ordered_levels.meaning: Implementation or documentation exists; no execution proof.
Focused deterministic or automated test executed.
Integrated flow executed against local or simulated dependencies.
Flow executed inside a host simulator; not real-host proof.
Checks executed against the exact clean candidate commit, tree, and dependency locks.
Flow executed on the named real host, network, or chain with exact provenance and required finality.
Observed participant journey with consent and redacted evidence.
Published artifact is cryptographically tied to the exact candidate and deployment record.
Useful local evidence of an unresolved blocker; it cannot promote state.

promotion_rules: Evidence may use only an ID declared by the accepted taxonomy.
local-blocked never promotes an outcome regardless of other scores.
A higher rank is scoped to its assertions and exact candidate; it does not upgrade unrelated claims.
Reviewer independence is recorded under evaluator independence, not encoded as an evidence level.
User proof requires live-user evidence and cannot be inferred from real-host-chain or release evidence.
